digest.component_or_area: code-review impact decider and pass-2 verifier
propositions: Deletion-impact and api-compat findings scoring below approved thresholds (0.60/0.51) due to removed public symbols not being recognized as unversioned contract breaks
Frequency multiplier must never dampen SERIOUS-tier findings; cold/new files (churn90=0) should amplify or hold steady, not suppress
Unversioned contract break classification requires gating: only TRUE when removal lacks major-version bump, deprecation cycle, or CHANGELOG breaking-change entry; managed removals are FALSE
Pass-2 sub-question detection of removed public symbols must key on EXPORT visibility (__all__, CLI command, MCP tool) not on presence/absence of cited callers
Impact boost for unmanaged removal of exported symbols (removed_public_symbol AND NOT version_signal_present) targets serious-tier tier; boost never lowers existing scores
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION transitions code-v4 to code-v5 due to semantic change in impact calculation for deletion-impact/api-compat findings
